title: RISE Changes: a system figure kind with reference cases
acceptance: The figure kit draws a system: 3 to 8 nodes (service, queue or store) on 4 columns and 3 rows, 2 to 10 links, and 2 or 3 states. What changed is drawn in the accent. The still is the last state with what it lacks dashed, and SMIL steps through the states with dots along live paths.
renderFigure(spec, { state }) draws a still of one state of a system and refuses any other kind or state.

figureProblems refuses, in plain sentences: a label over its budget, a link through another node or too short to see, a link label with no clear place, a legend wider than the frame, a link in a state its node lacks, and a system with no states and nothing changed.
Every system figure is admitted and layout-clean in every theme and brand, on the room's ground and its own.
The composer is shown a system example and its budgets from KIT_BUDGETS, and is steered to a system when the pull requests name the services, queues or stores a change runs through.

Reference cases from real pull requests live in src/core/figures/fixtures/systems.js. Each case's animation and each state's still are goldens, and npm run figures:systems draws them onto a contact sheet from a fresh checkout with no model, network or browser.
docs/plans/SYSTEM-FIGURES.md explains how to add a case and names the stable entry points.

evidence.note: Branch claude/project-thread-1oazj7, local (Linux, Node 22): npx vitest run src/core/figures scripts/changes src/core/changes: 360 passed. Fast set has 6 failures in try-session, keystones and system-design, which fail the same way without this work. ci-hygiene, vite build, measure:first-load, docs:diagram (core module count only) and the wiki build are clean. The composer steering is unverified until another dry run: dry run 40649426916 (before the steering) chose no system figure.

activity.summary: Opened from the owner's ask for figures about dynamic system designs, then made reproducible: OpenStatus reference cases, state stills, a contact sheet command and a how-to.

summary: A system figure kind that draws the parts a change touched and steps through its states, with three OpenStatus reference cases held to goldens and a contact sheet command. Composer steering toward it is untested until the next dry run.
